result.scope: All seven fixed portraits, then paired duplicate/shared/shared/duplicate main-pass instrumentation in local Chromium at normal and Retina density. CPU and RAF timings are observational.

equivalence.posedVertices: Every tested skinned vertex in all seven posed rigs is numerically identical before and after sharing.
equivalence.portraits: All seven browser portraits are pixel-identical.
equivalence.bindTransforms: Different mesh bind transforms remain independent; unit tests preserve their distinct posed vertices.
equivalence.ownership: Unit tests check non-equivalent bones and inverse binds, idempotence, duplicate retirement and independent character instances.

benchmarkMethod: Same-scene duplicate/shared/shared/duplicate comparison at 1440x1000 CSS pixels, normal and Retina density. Baseline reconstructs per-mesh Skeleton clones with the same live bones; adaptive restores production shared skeletons. Each stage warms for 45 frames and samples 120 RAF intervals. Main-pass Skeleton.update and texSubImage2D calls are instrumented; temporary clones and hooks are cleaned up.
limits: Live pedestrians change visibility slightly across benchmark stages; initial baseline/shared stages have matching draw calls and triangle submissions.
CPU timings include instrumentation and are observational; paired structural update/upload counts establish the direct reduction.
The new unpaired district profile has median 16.7 ms and p95 33.4-50 ms. Neither it nor the paired runs establishes sustained 60 FPS.
Lip synchronization, expressive facial acting, material and cloth realism, and broader frame pacing remain open.
